title: PROV-106 DeepSeek overlay
content: DeepSeek provider still emits reasoning_content from a legacy overlay; migration must preserve/declare reasoning_content instead of only renaming model to model_id.

title: PROV-108 Responses dual protocol
content: OpenAI Responses integration uses reasoning + tool_use protocol in v2; treating it as ordinary chat completions breaks tool routing.

title: Backup snapshot fingerprint
content: Before CI updates, snapshot must include integration_id, schema_version, model/model_id, status, health_bucket, reasoning_content flag, protocol, and redacted credential fingerprint.

title: Design-only migration guard
content: This task should submit a migration plan, not call config_update_integration or config_notify in the live config service.

title: Batch order caveat
content: Degraded/planned integrations should not be migrated blindly before active critical providers; CI batches need canary and rollback gates.

title: Cross-check primary service facts with review traps
content: Final plan should cite concrete source_ids, handle every trap class, and confirm the submitted review payload.
